gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a gross prior year strengthening of GBP 24.453m in 2019 (gross change in prior year provisions), driven predominantly by adverse development on previously written Property business (movement of approximately US$16m / GBP 12.6m attaching to 2018 and earlier years) and a reduction in previously accrued reinsurance recoveries on 2017 hurricane losses (c. GBP 3.4m). The adverse development principally relates to property catastrophe and large loss experience and reduced reinsurance recoveries, resulting in an overall strengthening of prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Losses however continued to be reported from the previously underwritten Property book, attaching to the 2018 and prior underwriting years with movement in losses in the year amounting to US$16m (GBP 12.6m @ 1.27).
This was in addition to a reduction in previously accrued for reinsurance recoveries on 2017 Hurricane losses of US$ 4.3m (GBP 3.4m @ 1.27) which was impacted by the hours clause.

The increase in the net loss ratio in 2019 to 85.0% (2018: 73.6%) is largely due to the higher than expected loss experience on the previously written property book, as noted in the Chief Executive Officer's report.
gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' (gross) = GBP 101,997k -> 101.997m (explicit). Prior year development taken from note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross) = GBP 24,453k -> 24.453m (explicit in Technical Provisions table). Some event amounts (e.g. US$ to GBP conversions cited in narrative) were reported in USD in the text and converted by the report at given FX rates; those converted figures were used where explicitly given in GBP. No per-LOB quantified breakout of the total prior year development is provided in the notes, therefore per-LOB amounts (except where explicitly stated, e.g. the c.GBP 3.4m reinsurance recovery reduction) are null. Named RDS event net losses are presented in the RDS table in the report and have been included with moderate confidence.
